[*]Enhanced wood containers so that only members of the originating claim can access them on PvE servers. This was widely requested, and is part of our commitment into making PvE experience about enjoyable teamwork.
[*]A massive update and rebuild to the character system for improved performance and visual acuity.
[*]Streamlined and improved Tutorial Mission to reduce player issues with mission performance.
[*]Loot rebalanced as requested to increase difficulty and improve long term game play – players will no longer find high end items.
[*]We softened the breathing sounds when wearing a spacesuit at player request.
[*]Improved the character creation system as part of our overall updating and preparation for the Unity update to 2019 version.
[*]Fixed some localization issues.  Thanks for those who helped us find these translation problems.
[*]Fixed the Grazer hack and improved performance and damage, as this was widely reported.
[/list]

Thanks for your continuous support, read on for the full update details.

Presenting - [b]Update # 8 (0.72)[/b]

[b]MAJOR UPDATES AND FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*]New character system – rewritten from the ground up – very large backend project fixing a number of issues and clearing way for future updates
[*]New vehicle system – rewritten from the ground up – very large backend project fixing a number of issues and clearing way for future updates
[*]Hijackable vehicles added - PowerCells required to hack a locked vehicle. 12 for spaceship, 7 for Rover, 4 for Quad Bike, 5 for Nova. Hijacking the vehicle will make you and your clan the new owner of the vehicle.
[/list]

[b]SERVER STABILITY AND PERFORMANCE[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the way server restarts work if server crashes, should hopefully get servers to come online within a minute of crashing
[*]Fixed a major sever crash when several vehicles were in use
[*]Vehicle rigs are only loaded when the player is within 2km of the vehicle – improving server performance
[*]Vehicle elements are now saved into a vehicle rig – improving vehicle server performance 50x
[*]Major improvement to how vehicles are handled by the game, greatly improving server stability and performance
[*]Picking up items and removing other items improved to fix  network delay 
[/list]

[b]MAJOR FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*]Makeshift and territory claims fixes to avoid being able to claim ownership on a makeshift claim ever again
[*]Vehicles now save their position constantly, to avoid vehicle continuing to move as player logs out or crashes
[*]World array now contains clan names in vehicle data – fixing issues with missing vehicles
[*]Locked vehicles can now be accessed clan wide if the player is in a clan, otherwise it can be access by the owning player only. 
[*]Entering a vehicle now has an extra call to make sure the vehicle is destroyed, to avoid duplication 
[*]Issue with landmines not destroying is resolved.
[*]Vehicles now allow access for the vehicle owner if a clan is created after the fact
[*]Several issue with vehicle at startup is resolved
[*]An extra check added to prevent additional vehicle bugs that were bugging out vehicles on dedicated server
[*]Fixed various issues when deleting a character, and certain progress being carried over to the new character.
[*]Fixed various bug when deleting claims
[*]Fixed a bunch of errors and bugs when using air vehicles that lead to extra server load
[*]Clan name now updated for a vehicle on vehicle entry + exit, fixing a number of problems of clan not being able to access vehicles
[*]Fixed an issue where territory claims could be deleted and makeshift claims could not.
[*]Clan owners can delete a Makeshift claim within that clan
[/list]

[b]PVE SERVER CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*]Wood Containers Clan Only for PVE Server – fixing a number of exploits and players abusing other players
[*]Death loot containers on PVE can only be opened by the owned player – mixing a number of player abuses
[*]Hijacking vehicles now only works on PvP servers and not part of PvE gameplay
[/list]

[b]MAJOR BALANCING CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed high end items from container and world loot
[*]Lowered credit gain from crafting and selling from 10% to 5%
[*]Rebalanced item costs for all items, making it a bit more expensive
[*]Rebalanced crafting receipts – in general it`s 1.5x harder now
[*]Lowered number of items for some loot types
[*]Fixed a number of crafting exploits
[*]Adjusted drop rates for world items to be 1.5x harder
[*]Grazer – now does damage to players in PvP
[*]Alderman Rack now gives bow and 50 arrows instead of a shotgun
[*]Placement radius around mines increased by 70 meters to avoid players placing claims there
[/list]

[b]MISC CHANGES AND FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced size of some unnecessarily huge textures – reducing RAM usage
[*]Grazer - fixed ray detection being wrong and colliding with the player itself, and even damaging it.
[*]Grazer - fixed and improved hit effects, range, and performance drain
[*]Grazer - fixed a number of bugs when changing weapon while using it
[*]Reduced running breath volume by 16db
[/list]

notes.title: Update 8 Preview
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

The team is busy working on the biggest update we had so far... and ETA is Thursday next week.

We wanted to share details of this update with you so that you know what`s coming. There are two parts to this update – some major behind the scenes projects, and some big gameplay changes. So lets go over the changes in some detail here:

[list]
[*]Server stability and reworked vehicle code – several days of work went into completely reworking the vehicle code that in turn will greatly improve server stability and fix last vehicle bugs
[*]Resolving last instances of server crashing and rebooting – things are getting better, but with this update we really hope to fully resolve occasional server restarts
[*]Hacking to steal vehicles – it will be possible to steal vehicles by hacking their security, consumes Power Cells. This will probably will only be allowed on PvP servers.
[*]Outlaw system – players griefing other players, or killing noobs, will get an Outlaw status, with 5 possible Wanted levels. Outlaw status lowers over time
[*]Outlaws will have a nav point visible to other players and a credits bounty on them – both will increase with wanted level. With higher wanted level – Mechs will shoot on sight, and some merchants will become unavailable
[*]Noob system – will gives some protection to players playing Prologue, or just starting Survival game - Players who will mess or kill players with Noob status will get an Outlaw status with higher Wanted level
[*]PvE servers will get additional protection – for example it`ll be impossible to steal from other player containers
[*]Reworked looting system balance – no more high-tier items, and  average loot is reduced by 65% – increasing the difficulty
[*]Reworked crafting system balance – on average progression will get 50% harder
[*]Reworked tutorial that`s designed not to give Tutorial players unfair advantages like space suit, shotgun or jetpack. So for example player will be give Bow and Arrows on Tigon. It won`t be possible to fly the spaceship to explore the space. And other changes to make Prologue more streamlined and not exploitable or OP
[*]First part of new character update – most of these updates are not visible to players but are improving character system, and there will be some difference visually. We had to get through this to complete all the non-art related work on the big upcoming character update.
[*]Updating Unity from 2017 to 2019 – this was held back due to needed to complete the character update. This will fix a number of bugs and performance issues, as well as allow us to improve game`s visuals more, and fix a number of rare start up bugs on older video cards and fix some rare crashes.
[*]Two dozen of other bug and exploit fixes across the board
[*]PvE servers get additional protection – for example it`ll be impossible to steal from other player containers
[/list]

So as you can see we have a major update in the works, and while we would like to apologize for the delay – extra time is needed to complete this update correctly. Wishing everyone a great weekend ahead, and we can`t wait to share this update with you next week.

notes.title: Update # 7 - First Milestone
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Before we jump to the big event today - we would like to thank all of our players who supported us during the turbulent, yet fun two weeks since Stars End went live on October 14th. For our small team this was a first experience releasing a game of this complexity and scale - and we are glad that in 16 days after launch we have finally reached our first milestone goal.

With today`s update we can confidently say that majority of the game breaking issues has been resolved. Now we are ready to start new phase of development – polishing and improving smaller issues and player experience across the board. And there`s still a lot of work in this department before we can finally get to improving graphics, characters and adding new content after that. Same time we will be able to fix smaller issues a lot faster now - as all the major server and networking update hurdles are out of the way.

As part of today`s update we are switching to 6 super-servers, half PvP, half PvE, capable of supporting 250 players each for now. We expect to push this further in the future.

Unfortunately we had to do a full on wipe; but we have to agree – wipe was badly needed. This was necessary due to switching to super servers, clearing the world after all the previous dupes and exploits have been fixed e.t.c. We do not expect another wipe for a very long time.

Keep in mind that while player population is low now, we will start major advertisement and promo events in the first week of December to boost the player population greatly. Meanwhile we still need 4 more weeks before Stars End is ready for this type of larger player pop.

During this time we`ll continue with 1-2 updates per week, fixing last remaining bugs, starting to polish things here and there, and expand the playable planets.

Please keep in mind - this was a HUGE update, so we won`t be surprised if something new will pop-up, but we`ll monitor the situation and if so - have a hot fix ready on the same day.

Thanks for your continuous support!

And so - presenting our first milestone - [b]Update # 7 (0.70)[/b]

[b]New Features & Major Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Switching to 6 super servers with 250 limit – to be expanded in the future
[*]Super servers split evenly around the globe with half PvP, half PvE
[*]Total wipe on all servers – must be also performed on dedicated servers
[*]Complete rewrite of all network code behind claims and territory
[*]Fixed over 20 issues and bugs related to claims and territories
[*]Server and networking performance is increased several fold
[/list]

[b]Fixes and Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved server stability and resolved some rare causes of server crashing
[*]Corrected some server issues when riding the Ferry.
[*]Changed Nova controls to act more like a normal ship
[*]Landing Pad completely reworked – has a terminal, and allows custom placement of vehicle
[*]Moved crafted ship spawn from landing pad to player inventory
[*]Issues with claims disappearing or being inaccessible resolved
[*]Wild horses no longer show a saddle
[*]Fixed falling through terrain when spawning on a claim with a base
[*]Fixed Spacesuit set not working properly - invisible suit and shadow issues
[*]Fixed makeshift suit not working at all
[*]Claims no longer invisible during placement 
[*]Window and Door placement nodes separated
[*]Improvements in stuck command. It now also searches vertically for a suitable place.
[*]Implemented saving last used server settings - for solo/personal/dedicated
[*]Corrected some animation issues and optimized game graphics
[/list]


[b]Misc and Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Corrected inventory duplication on death exploit
[*]Adjusted player when standing, crouching and proning – making it impossible to look through walls - wall view exploit
[*]Fixed several vehicle exploits
[*]Fixed an issue where base components could be picked up with ignition key while in a vehicle
[*]Ground tiller rotation resolved
[*]Can no longer make a base inside a territory hub
[*]Ground tillers can only be placed on terrain
[*]Watch Towers can now be picked up
[*]Fixed an issue where the territory claim could be deleted
[*]Fixed range of territory claims to 300m, preventing personal claims from overlapping or being placed inside territory claims.
[*]Fixed issue with territory guardian attacking current owner.
[*]Fixed requirement to destroy Guardian mech(s) in order to set a territory claim.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update Tomorrow!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

As you might have heard we are doing the "big move" tomorrow. 

[b]Major Update[/b]
To start things off we are releasing our biggest updated so far - that includes major rewrites of the server and claims code; we also have fixed the last of the game breaking bugs. Some quality of life improvements in this update as well - like new NOVA controls and much more.

[b]Switching to super servers[/b]
Same time we will be migrating to the new servers, going from 17 small servers that could barely function with 40 players online to 6 super-servers, that for now can comfortably support 250 players each, but that will be expanded in the near future. Half the servers will be PvP, half PvE, and they will cover the world nicely - with 2 in Asia, 2 in Europe and 2 in US.

[b]Wipe[/b]
...there`s no way around this - due to complexity of this update, and changing to bigger servers - we need to perform a wipe. But lets face it - it`s BADLY needed. Previous duping issues and exploit left many players with millions of credits, and the game world is also quite corrupted from the days when land claims could be placed anywhere.

After tomorrow we don`t expect another wipe for a long time!

[b]Getting Stars End ready for prime time[/b]
Keep in mind that while player population is low now, we will start major advertisement and promo events in the first week of December to boost the player population greatly. Meanwhile we still need 4 more weeks before Stars End is ready for this type of larger player pop.

During this time we`ll continue with 1-2 updates per week, fixing last remaining bugs, starting to polish things here and there, and expand the playable planets.

And finally - we just want to reassure you, that after tomorrow`s update all the issues that been plaguing the game for the past couple of weeks - like disappearing claims, spawning inside you base floor, missing vehicles e.t.c - should all be a thing of the past.

However - this is a HUGE update we are doing tomorrow, so I won`t be surprised if something new will pop-up, but we`ll monitor the situation and if so - have a hot fix ready on the same day.


Thanks for your support, your reviews and bug reports! We could not have gotten through the first 2 weeks without your help!

notes.title: Update # 6 - Major Update

Hey Everyone,

[*]We`ll finally have all the exploits fixed - right now quite a few players have millions of credits

notes.title: Update # 4 - Weekend Ready
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Another day - another great update. The team continues to push extra hard to get Stars End into good shape for next week. Ground vehicles, FPS camera and server stability also got some loving - improving things across the board. And horses also got some carrots - with various improvements and fixes.

notes.title: Day Three - 3rd Update - Big Steps
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Thanks again for your support during the launch week, the team is pushing hard, and we are back with the third update. You can ready full details below, but to highlight things: storage containers will now work, also the several servers that`s been down from Tuesday are back. Prologue now has an intro cinematic. A lot of quality of life improvements like holding LMB to gather resources, and a lot more stability, lag reduction and other bug fixes. 

Please note - that some players will loose their Claims as part of today`s big update. This does not effect characters or anything else - as this is not a wipe.

We continue working full speed - and you can expect another major Update 4 by Monday (or a smaller Update 4 by tomorrow...we`ll see) Update 4 will include reworked TPS camera with custom zoom levels, as well as fixes to all the vehicle issues, and so much more.

notes.title: Day One - 2nd Update - Loot Fixes
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Thanks for your support and sticking with us on Day 1. We are glad to see so many new players joining us, and we are especially grateful for not getting killed with negative reviews on day 1.

The team has been at it all day and night, and we are happy to present a big Day One update 1 and 2, - that iron out majority of launch issues. As you might have noticed - servers on launch were not running that well - sometimes kicking players, and often lagging on actions. We are glad to say major of this has now been resolved. 

In out second update we have also fixed all the world loot issues.

[b]Please keep in mind - that we had to take down of a few of the servers for a long maintenance - they`ll be back in 24 hours with player data intact. Sorry again last of Day 1 issues, but yeah - just offline for a bit[/b]

This update also comes with several other important changes. This update was a huge undertaking as launch came with a rude awakening - our database needed to be upgraded. All the testing we`ve done during Alpha testing period could not prepare us for the big server issue that a large number of players - playing at once - have revealed today. The downside of small indie developer handling a big launch.

The team continues work full speed on a Day 2 update, more great updates to come!

With that said - presenting [b]Update # 1(0.652) & Update # 2(0.653)[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed all world loot issues - containers and loot will create loot
[*]Completely new database used by the game world server - faster, and more efficient
[*]Server stability greatly improved, minimizing players getting kicked from the server
[*]Server performance significantly improved - a lot less lag when performing actions
[*]Over a dozen other server performance related bugs fixed all across the board
[*]Clan invite not working most of the time is fixed
[*]New craft-able item added - Horse Saddle, required to claim a wild horse
[*]To claim a horse player now needs to craft a Horse Saddle
[*]Fixed inverted mouse not working right when flying a spaceship
[*]Fixed exploit with Prologue Winter Quest
[/list]

notes.title: Last Day of Alpha - Update 0.632
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Today`s major update finally completes the Early Access build. We are glad to say that in the last big push over the weekend we have managed to resolve all the leftover game breaking bugs and finally get the game servers stable. We will have one more pre-launch update tomorrow fixing the current few remaining noticeable bugs.

At this point we have the Worldwide Server running smoothly - and time has come to push it to the full capacity - with upwards of 100 players online at once. 

If you have a bit of time today around 11am EST - 3pm EST, please join us and play the game on the Official Worldwide server. We`ll keep one server running for the next 10 hours, before bringing all the 15+ game servers online for tomorrow`s launch.

We also want to take a moment to say Big Thank You to all of our alpha testers! Your help during the past month was essentual in helping us prepare for Early Access launch.

And so presenting [b]update 0.632[/b]:

[b]Server Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]New claim management server system due to claims filling up the scene quite fast
[*]Server scans player locations to see if a networked claim is required for that position
[*]Sun code merged with solar system values for better server performance
[*]A fix for world objects not destroying for the hosting player, as the slot was getting cleared before the object was destroyed.
[*]Placed components now pickup immediately for the local player to avoid duplication
[*]Local vehicles now pickup immediately for the local player to avoid duplication
[*]An effect controller error resolved while playing on a server
[*]Big array issue fixed with loading data
[*]Fixed an issue where area components could be loaded before data is received
[*]Small code refactoring related to shutdown server command.
[*]Changed the way players get data from the array at startup, one call per existing array entity, if it is filled, as opposed to one network call per sub array which will resolve server load and potentially errors when sending out area data.
[*]Some misc errors fixed at startup
[*]Fixed some misc errors when playing on a server
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes and improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed not being able to exit a ship if going into pilot seat really fast after entering the ship.
[*]Resolved the issue with infinite loot containers, not correctly clearing out its item slot on the server
[*]Elevators now move on universal time rather than a networked value.
[*]Fixed a bug with fuel not storing properly in ground vehicles
[*]Fixed a bug with vehicle disappearing on logging out
[*]Added a block to be able to initialize global prompt if the ui is active, which should stop global prompt being activated while already open
[*]Further fixes to hopefully resolve container already opened messages, especially if a hosting player opens one.
[*]Temporarily disabled LOD transitions for bushes and trees to avoid a flickering related Unity bug.
[*]Fixed NPC sitting on nothing in Clayton Town.
[*]In case Discord is not open, the game will try to connect to it a maximum of 5 times, instead of forever, since each attempt has a performance cost
[*]Fixed radio auto turning off.
[*]Workaround to not break sleeping when opening a menu or chat.
[*]Fixed bed interaction in several places.
[/list]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved TPS camera rotation while pressing ALT in air ships.
[*]Some text validation in chat input text. It won't allow empty messages, new lines, and it will trim empty spaces at the beginning and the end of a message.
[*]Improved and optimized some Tigon trees to support wind, and LOD distances adjustments.
[*]New Invert Mouse Y setting.
[*]Player log in and out messages will only show in the chat, instead of both chat and top notifications.
[/list]

notes.title: Stars End: Alpha Update 0.629
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

As we are crunching towards Early Access launch in 4 days, we have another major alpha update today. We`ll continue with daily updates all the way until launch... well actually I guess we`ll continue with daily updates after launch as well... We`ll rest next year:)

And to confirm Stars End launch is schedule for 3pm EST, on Thursday October 10th. We will have at least 10 official servers live for launch, and can expand with more by Friday evening depending on player numbers.

For now we`ll only keep 1 official server running, as we really want to start trying to max out sever population, and soon try the waiting ques. 

[u][b]And so presenting update 0.629[/b][/u]

-Several new servers added covering Europe, Asian and various US locations (offline for now to help stress test just 1 server)

[b]Network Optimizations[/b]

Players at a distance now you use the minimum amount of data required. (The player prefab is now 100kb instead of 8.5mb.) There is always more work to go here but this has been a giant leap towards stable servers!

[b]UI[/b]
- Descriptions added to Global Prompt for Items, Unclaimed vehicles and TreeLogs.
- Fixes in Quantity selection window and other places: it won't allow entering wrong values like letters, negative numbers, and numbers that exceed the maximum amount allowed. This avoids several issues related to being able to duplicate all the items you want. PLEASE test buying, selling, splitting, dropping, taking from storage and moving to storage.

notes.title: Stars End: Private Beta Update 0.60 + Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/494e1d09cd50149fa46e5ba588fce3130ab2eb32.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/33bb21ef3d276719b23fa7fd39c1b313e63f62d8.png[/img][/url]

[u][b]Game Update v0.60[/b][/u]

[h1][b]Release Date Announcement: 6th September![/b]

Greetings Outlanders!  We are happy to announce Stars End will finally enter Early Access on the 6th September (yes, that is 2019!)  We have come a long way from our humble beginnings of an experiment to see if procedural planets were within our abilities, into a full fledged, combat based, multiplayer hardcore survival game with territory capture! 

Expect to see many updates from us over the coming weeks as we make the transition from Private Beta to a public release![/h1]


[u][b]Territory[/b][/u]
Due to player feedback, territory has been changed to be less reliant on player crafted structures, and instead are comprised of purchased structures available via the Territory Management UI (accessible on the claim)

Upon approaching a territory, if it has no owner only the control tower will be present. Approach the claim and initiate the capture timer to take over (which takes 10 minutes currently.)  A defending clan can cancel this timer and send it in the opposite direction, in order to retake the territory.

[b]Unlockable buildings include:[/b]
-Crew Quarters
-Refinery
-Landing Tower

[b]Unlockable Defenses include:[/b]
- Inner Wall
- Outer Wall
- Outer Shield  + Shield Generator
- Mech AI which patrols the inside of a territory and attacks non clan members

[b]Unlockable Vendors include:[/b]
- Land Vehicle Vendor
- Air Vehicle Vendor
- Weapons Vendor

*Additionally, territories still support placement of custom crafted objects, such as landmines, defenses and custom structures. It is not required anymore but can be used to add extra fortifications to your territory. 

**For this weekend, only 1 territory is enabled in order for extensive testing. This is Redberry located beside Clayton Shire Spaceport. The other territories in the shire will be reactivated on Monday.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/067da9e27e98988e04a3a96dc3b07ba89ea7f35a.jpg[/img]
[i]A capturable territory (Redberry) with a shield enabled, and all the components purchased[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/0d75f76dd1f332206158cd0b71f75cf5f584b5f6.jpg[/img]
[i]Clayton Town has been finally enabled in the middle of Clayton Shire[/i]

[u][b]Changelog[/b][/u]

[b]The database has been wiped.[/b]

[b]AI[/b]
- Refactored some AI actions to be reusable with multiple AI types.
- Navigation mesh on capturable Clayton.
- Mech rotation fixes when in a planet.
- Fixed layout and nav mesh in capturable Clayton and finished implementing ProtectTerritory AI Action for the Mech.
- Navigation meshes for the rest of the territories.

Updated MechClanNew material.

- Fixed an issue that could make the Mech not attack the player some times.

- Implemented behaviour for new static mechs. After losing the attack target or killing it, they will go back to their spawn position and stand there.
- Network fixes to Mech AI and small optimizations.

[b]Swimming[/b]

- Colliders finally added for water on planets, the player detects this and enters swimming mode

[b]Water[/b]

[b]Items[/b]

-WoodContainer - WoodPanks 8, Nails 4, removed requirement for Iron Bar

NEW RECIPES!

[u][b]Update v0.590[/b][/u]

[b]The database has been wiped.[/b]

[b]Territory Capture[/b]

[i]After the last major update we tested the territory capture extensively. The biggest concern was lack of protection so for this update, that's what we have focused on and made the following changes:[/i]

• Territory claims are no longer purchased, and already present in towns at game load. Approach a claim to begin capturing it for your clan.
• Walls added around each capturable POI, you can limit player entry by crafting a WoodGate to fortify your Territory.
• Crafting and placing a generator in your Territory will enable a Forcefield around your Territory Claim. Players must destroy the generator to bring down the forcefield. Territory owners can place as many generators as they like.. each one must be destroyed!

• There are 4 capturable towns in Clayton Shire, we will be looking to replicate these capturable locations across the Solar System as soon as it's ready to do so.

• Rain FX tweaks.

• Weapons lose integrity at a fraction of the speed as before.
• Fog overlap issues resolved over distance terrain.

[b]Note:[/b] We need one more weekend to gather data from the Territory Capture mechanics, the prologue missions will be re-enabled early next week.

notes.title: Stars End: Private Beta Update 0.585
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]Game Update v0.580[/b][/u][/h1]

We have a huge update this week for Stars End which finally introduces our first version of Territory Capture for the game! The challenge always was to find a way that we could implement base building features into Territory Capture to unite different aspects of the game, and with that we're introducing a new item: Territory Claims.

To takeover a town in Stars End, firstly you need to create or join a clan, which you can do from the UI. Then you need to purchase a Territory Claim from the Exchange on an Orbital Station - placing it in the middle of your chosen town (if it is not already captured.)

This will open up various features in the town, depending on your Clan permission level, such as purchasing Mechs for defenses (they attack any non clan member entering town!) and claiming Tax from Vendors, and also setting up a custom message for the area.

Your build radius covers the entire town. You will also find 2 or more empty building lots in the town to build custom structures. Custom structures can also be built around the Centrepoint POI in the middle of towns to fortify your Claim. Claims can be captured by another clan which takes 10 minutes to capture.

So far we have added capturable towns to Beta Prairie, which consists of Redberry, the largest town and also 4 satellite towns not too far down the road. The prologue has disabled temporarily for this update so we can have everyone testing our the feature.

For those who would rather avoid towns completely and camp in the wild, we still support this via our Makeshift Claim. These are craftable and placeable almost anywhere in the game and allow an assortment of items to be placed in your camp (excluding custom structures which are reserved for towns.)

We anticipate we'll be needing a couple of hotfixes over the weekend with these big changes arriving so let us know if you encounter any game breaking issues! Patch notes below screenshots.

[h1][u][b]Screenshots[/b][/u][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/6ade7d17bec3b68cf770ecaa8007c50bf9f4b011.jpg[/img]
[i]A centrepoint POI before a Territory Claim has been placed. The concrete pads around it are used for building custom structures.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/365ca58d684ae7e65139dfaaeed7766d521974e9.jpg[/img]
[i]A Territory Claim that has  been Fortified[/i]

[h1][u][b]Changelog[/b][/u][/h1]

[u][b]Hotfix v0.585[/b][/u]

• Deleting a claim now stores the claim in your inventory.
• You can now pickup storage containers, but it will destroy any items inside.
• Pin code issue on doors should be resolved
• Territory Claim custom messages will no longer reset.
• New WoodShack art implemented.
• Big foliage loading optimizations. Moving around a planet should be much smoother.
• Adjustments to some abandoned shacks and fixed bed interactions.
• Optimizations to several buildings

[u][b]Hotfix v0.583/4[/b][/u]
• Fomenko's Fine Dining Diner Upgraded.
• Clayton Mine upgraded.
• Campfire art and effect improved.
• Fixed an error in campfire tooltips.

[u][b]Hotfix v0.582[/b][/u]
• An issue with terrain colliders not generating after travelling some distance should be resolved.
• Fixed a bug in mining
• Empty bottle weight decreased
• Ferry no longer clips through Prairie Orbital Station

[u][b]Hotfix v0.581[/b][/u]
• A bug that occurred in clan creation has been resolved

[u][b]Update v0.580[/b][/u]

[b]This update has required a database wipe.[/b]

[b]Territory Capture[/b]
• MakeshiftClaim - place a craftable makeshift claim in the world to build a wide assortment of items out in the wild. This does not allow players to build custom structures.
• LandClaim removed.
• TerritoryClaim - purchasable from The Exchange on Orbital Stations and placeable in the middle of capturable villages at the Centrepoint POI. Territory Claims are capturable in a 10 minute timer. They cannot be destroyed. They allow the player to build custom structures on 3 building lots around the town, aswell as building a fortification around a centrepoint POI to protect their claim. 
Claims also collect taxes from vendors in town and place 2 mechs on a circuit around the town (taxes and mechs coming tomorrow, almost there!) Mechs will also be colored red and attack any non clan member on sight!
• The 10 minute capture time can be cancelled by the owning clan, and then it starts moving in the opposite direction.
• Claims now allow the storage of custom messages, displayable when you enter the area of on the respawn screen
• Players can spawn at any claim within their clan.
• You must create or join a clan to able to place a claim.
• Red Mech type added - this attacks wildlife plus non clan members
• Ability to purchase mechs added to Claim Management Screen. 
• General store vendors linked to claim system and charge 10% tax
• Tax can be claimed by clan owner via the Claim Management Screen
• 4 New Capturable POIs added near Redberry! These are half the size of Redberry and are regarded Satellite towns. For players who want to capture an outpost but avoid the main firefight expected to happen at Ferry Port Towns.
• Dirt roads added around Redberry Satellite towns.
• Reworked create clan to search a list of existing clans, to ensure two clans cant have the same name.

[b]Items[/b]
• Crafting items is a lot cheaper now and requires less scrap metal based resources and more iron found in rocks around the system. Includes base building and vehicle components.
• New items: Tarphite and RefinedTarphite which are obtainable from the shire mine and usable in some rare recipes, and also worth a decent amount of coin.
• Cleaned up a bunch of base components data

[b]Melee[/b]
• New Melee System (Wood Axe and Pickaxe) - it now uses proper hit detection with Trigger Colliders attached to the blades, with a much more reliable hit
• 'Whoosh' Audio added for using a Melee Weapon (any new audio is placeholder but also not too bad!)
• Hit Audio now implemented for hitting various surface types
• Combat Knife and Machete added
• Combat Knife is craftable.

[b]Vehicles[/b]
• New camera movement for land vehicles and some optimizations.
• When entering a land vehicle, it will keep first or third person camera instead of always going to first person.
• Fixed camera bug when exiting and entering again a land vehicle.
• Particle effects improvements in a bunch of vehicles.
• Implemented rear view mirrors on vehicles.
• QuadBike: Mesh and materiall optimizations and improvements, added rear view mirrors.
• New mode for mirrors to render only on odd or even frames.
• Camera doesn't rotate when UI is visible while in FPS in a vehicle.
• Code refactoring: new vehicle camera controllers separated in different classes instead of all being in CameraControl.
• Improved Rover camera movement and now allows rotation.
• Camera rotation speed in vehicles now takes Mouse Sensitivity setting into account.
Adjustments in ground vehicles speeds.
• Fixed passenger interaction with land vehicles.
• Repair Tigon Fighter mission shows the tooltip about reparing the ship after entering instead of after ignition, and the mission complete notification shows after ignition instead of after entering the ship.
• A Vehicle Mission can be specified to complete OnEnter or OnIgnition.
• In an airship, when turning off power, it will also turn off ignition.

[b]Explosions[/b]
• Landmine returns as a placeable object, placement in the world expires within an hour, place on your claim to store permanently.
• Organization for explosions (so we have them ready for upgrading!)
• Grenade audio issue fixes
• Grenade now gives proper damage

[b]Environment[/b]
• Major Reworkings of Clayton Shire on Beta Prairie, to introduce Territory Capture features.
• Hamills POI majorly updated in Solomans Redemption also with Vendors that apply taxes.
• Redberry Waypoint updated to point to the town rather than spaceport to avoid confusion
• Grass upgraded on Beta Prairie

[b]Waypoints[/b]
• Optimizations in text rendering.
• Fixed some occasional errors by WaypointManager due to removing elements in the waypoint array while iterating that array.
• Fixed extra errors in WaypointManager.

[b]Notifications[/b]
• Now there's the possibility to set independent duration to each notification in the array.
• Implemented notification colors.
• Transitions and fade outs when notifications disappear.
• Previously, if trying to set more than 5 notifications at the same time, the newer ones would simply be ignored, causing possibly loss of important information. Now they go to a queue, so even if there's maximum 5 visible, they keep being stored and they will be appearing after the top notification vanishes.

[b]Misc[/b]
• Several Female animations have been integrated.
• Loading screen tooltips updated for recent changes, plus some new ones added.
• Fixed player weapon network errors.
• Fixed pickaxe not obtaining iron.
• Fixed a network bug in player footsteps.
• Fixed a network bug related to bases.
• Fixed errors in the Foliage Manager.
• Chat optimizations.

• Bug fix for Fuel storage in vehicles, occasionally causing the vehicle to revert to no fuel.
• Revised third person camera for Land Vehicles.
• Beta Prairie Water detail increased.

[u][b]Game Update v0.570[/b][/u]

[b]This update has not required a database wipe.[/b]

[b]Land Vehicles[/b]
• New physics system for all Land Vehicles.The system uses wheel colliders that now work as intended on planets. This is a big step up, the wheel colliders allow much more precise control and allow rolling up gutters and other steps.
• Also some modifications to Land Vehicle meshes.
• Some improvements to Headlights in Land Vehicles and also implemented being able to toggle lights with L key.
• Improved tire smoke effects in vehicles.

[b]Air Vehicles[/b]
• Air Vehicle Waypoints: Vehicle waypoints show with player name, if the ignition is on. While on planet they are visible from 15km and in space visible for 500km (requires network testing).
• Networked speed better in ships and ensure the correct FX are playing for all passengers.
• Thruster changes according to networked speed.
• Booster starts and turns off for all passengers.
• Burn up FX starts and turns off for all passengers.
• Camera shake turns on and off for all passengers.
• Added culling distance to vehicles to ensure FX code isnt running on vehicles in other locations.
• Adjusted simulation speed on all thrusters to reduce flickering when travelling at a decent speed.
• Fixed an issue where pre warp fx would not disable if the player exits boost mode before its ready.
• Bug fix with air vehicle thrusters not displaying on network.

[b]Misc[/b]
• Weather enabled properly on Janson and Beta Prairie. This is a first pass on weather which will become more advanced in time. It has a chance to change Weather States on the network every 8 mins. Clear Sky more common than foggy or rain/blizzards. Can all be tweaked to perfection over time!
• Waypoints added to every planet-side ferry port throughout the system. For planets they activate at 100km, and moons 50km.
• Issue with global loot and storage containers storing the wrong value is resolved.
• Fix for Janson Frigate Mission Waypoint 
• Foliage optimization - checkbox added to foliage data to disable specific foliage not to load when flying eg grass and stones.
• Tigon jungle audio loop added.
• Updated Network API to latest version.

notes.title: Stars End Update 0.558 now live!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/916afbb9d714b94d37637a9e101ec8a9cb8d9550.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/211012ab70d6638ac55fbce2ae00c7d9181ed89a.png[/img][/url]

[u][b]Game Update v0.558[/b][/u]

[b]This update has not required a database wipe.[/b]

[b]Vehicles[/b]
• Reduced fuel consumption in ships.
• Increased max booster speed in ships.
• Showing more specific text when a vehicle runs out of fuel and some refactoring.
• When a ship runs out of fuel audio now cancels properly, aswell as warp speed effects, and engine disables.
• Changed the way vehicle exit works with a server call. passenger information now stored on server rather than vehicle owner.
• Implemented automatic engine turn off after landing.
• Redone command panel buttons for airships: now they are toggles, they remain highlighted if the button is on, their actions are handled through event listeners.
• New tooltip in tutorial when air vehicle automatically interrupts boost mode when approaching a planet.
• Fixed issue where fuel would stop being consumed while the pause menu is open, even if the ship is still moving.
• Several fixes to some functions, like stopping the ship when approaching a planet and particle effects, that would not work correctly if not in the pilot seat.
• Fixed: player was able to shoot while walking around the ship.
• Not allowed to shoot while in cruise or boost mode to avoid precision errors. Not necessary to be able to shoot at those speeds anyway.
• Improved bullet sound handling and some optimizations.
• Workaround to fix the ship movement going much faster when not in the pilot seat.

[b]Environment[/b]
• Updated various structures around Redberry, plus several optimizations.
• Removed a container in Orbital station that would block NPC Winter.
• Balcony's on apartments updated to resolve some geometry issues.
• Camera movement in walk in ship mode now stops while ui is open.
• Orbital Station upgraded with exchange and docks.

[b]Misc[/b]

• Hunger reverted to previous values but will keep a lookout for this on steam when build goes live.
• Spawn screen will now show your recommended spawn location by default, if playing the tutorial.
• Fixed Nagus NPC throwing errors when trying to completed sidequest.
• Hazard and cold protection added to atmosphere area's.
• All buildings in Raleigh and Delta Shires are updated with protection from hazards, with shapes fitted to each building/POI shape. Everything updated except for the makeshift shanty's, plus some misc optimizations across the POIs.
• crafting window cleaned up to stop confusion, and display information better.
• crafting list now shows items that you cannot craft darker, so items that you can craft stand out a lot better.
• many new icons are implemented.
• Bug fixed that caused area objectives plus recommended spawns to misbehave!
• Flashlight and Grazer positioning fixed.
• Greyed out icon color adjustments for crafting.
Improved interaction with beds and lockers inside ships:
• More precise interaction area.
• Highlighting now works correctly (in lockers it wasn't working and in beds wouldn't necessarily highlight the object when interactable).
• Localized interaction texts and now shows the actual interaction button mapped by the player.

notes.title: Stars End Update 0.541 now live!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/494e1d09cd50149fa46e5ba588fce3130ab2eb32.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/33bb21ef3d276719b23fa7fd39c1b313e63f62d8.png[/img][/url]

[h1][i][b]Greetings Outlanders,

We have a whole bunch of fixes for this patch. We're putting more focus into resolving all the issues over content for the time being, so you will see more of these updates over the next couple weeks.

This update has required a database wipe.[/b][/i][/h1]

[u][b]Changelog v0.541[/b][/u]

[b]Environment[/b]
• Abandoned Hangar: The area has been recreated to fix several issues in previous structure.
• New Raleigh: New POIs added to fill out the town a bit more.
• Grafton: New layout for the town and filler buildings have been removed.
• Janson: 80% small rocks removed on planet which were causing issues when driving.
• Beta Prairie: Environment and color adjustments
• Orbital Station: New station created to replace the old generic POI used. It's much bigger and now looks like a space station. Implemented at the 5 orbital station positions around Stars End.
• Titan: Added fill light to better illuminate Lt Diesel. Less reverb in cryo room. Lowered the volume of some ambient sounds & fixed NPC that was being blocked by another NPC.
• Kallus: Lowered volume of Miriam's voice.
• Hopper Crater: Removed some lootable containers, added Mercantile Walkers. Fixed some small layout and collision issues.
• Delta Shire: Adjustments to roads and road block signs around shire.

[b]Fixes[/b]
• Improvements to the movement of the ferry when landing after buying a ferry pass. Now it's interpolated, avoiding abrupt movements. Still more work to be done here.
• Changes for vehicle + horse positioning on the network when getting out, in order to stop offsets occurring
• Issue with using GlobalLootTerminal resolved
• /UI Chat Command to disable UI fixed and now allows movement.
• When AIs receive damage, they now receive data of which player did the damage. This makes more precise and efficient the AI attacking to the correct player.
• Implemented volume adjustments on NPC's
• Janson Frigate waypoint issue resolved.
• Added another NPC to speak to on Titan, placed inside the Hangar, in order to finish Light Repairs quest.
• Ground vehicles: lowered engine volumes, adjusted falloff ranges, increased max speed (friction was preventing rovers from moving at the previous max speed).
• New idle animation for players at loading screen/character creation
• Waypoint should no longer show during intro cutscene.
• Clothes should now change properly on network but requires testing
• Ferry camera adjusted so head objects dont cause issues
• Merchant exploit fixed with nails and ammo
• Tigon Horse no longer floats
• Horses use considerably less stamina when galloping
• Increased landing height for the Ferry in Janson space port.
• Forest Cub AI Material issue fixed

notes.title: Stars End Update 0.540 now live!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/fb9bfaa83d4902776242893285dda50ccc784369.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/e75a06e6ce7dc2b4b11c3b68e5a37e92fd00cc34.png[/img][/url]

[i][h1][b]Greetings Outlanders,

It has been a month since our last update but we've been working just as hard as ever on Stars End, and we can finally release our new features to the testing community! 

The servers are back online! This update has required a database wipe. Due to the amount of changes we'll be keeping a close eye on the game and releasing hot-fixes as necessary over the next couple days.[/b][/h1][/i]

[u][b]Game Update v0.540[/b][/u]

[b]Revamped Planets[/b]
Janson and Tigon have been redesigned from the ground up, including new Terrain, Biomes, Roads, Towns and several other handcrafted locations. Players are now able to survive and loot on both worlds with adequate resources available. (although building on Janson wont be easy until we add our Concrete Tier of Building Materials)

 [b]Space Flight [/b]
Space Flight has been revamped with 5 defined speed modes and improved speed handling. Ships will now detect what type of environment you are in and adjust speeds accordingly. New features added such as slowing down when close to the ground and UI fixes on the vehicles.
• Many bug fixes and handling issues addressed.
• New vehicle: The Janson Frigate. Players will get a chance to fly the JansonFrigate during a mission early on in the story. Another version of this Frigate which will support several passengers is arriving shortly.

[b]Commercial Radio[/b]
No longer will you have to do the long haul between Janson and Tigon in silence. With the introduction of 5 radio stations to Stars End, players can finally travel in style! Cycle through stations or even turn the radio off! Most vehicles come with a Radio already equipped. But that's not all folks, an even larger selection of the Future's Greatest Hits will be arriving asap!

[b]Hazards[/b]
Hazard system created and enabled on Tigon. Players now must find a Respirator, wear protective Gear or eat a herb called Diplazite in intervals, found throughout the environment, to protect yourself against poison deadly gasses!

[b]Main Menu & Game Options[/b] 
• Options have been implemented with graphics, audio and keybinding tabs with options stored locally on your PC. 
• Several new graphics and audio options are available. 
• Main menu and escape menu now share same options menu/settings.
• Improved layouts with more options added such as 'Go Back', Game Announcements and visual enhancements throughout.

[b]Base building & Storage [/b]
Foundations have been removed and replaced with Floors. Place craftable Floors on the ground or snap them together to build your own custom foundation. Other base pieces have been adjusted to fit this new way of building.
• Storage Containers are now available in the crafting menu and placeable on your LandClaim. Containers support 100 stacks of items at a time, and have no weight limit (although theres a very good chance we could revise this down the road.)
• Loot Access Points are no longer craftable for your base but still exist in the environment.

[b]Ladders[/b]
Ladder System created and ladder objects added throughout the Tigon environment (they will be craftable soon enough!) This feature has only just arrived so we'll be paying attention for any issues here once we go live.

[b]Misc[/b]
• Voice Chat - completely new proximity voice chat system implemented and customizable via keybinding options.
• Changes to harvesting and crafting. Animations and audio now play for the set time it takes to create/retrieve the items.
• Path selection removed after Character Creation - leading all new players directly towards the Titan ship stationed near Janson. Players have the option to leave the story and travel in any direction at any time, unlocking spawns, building and fighting, as you explore the system.
• Several bug fixes for Horses
• New grass rendering system created and implemented on major planets. You'll see a general improvement in visuals across most major planets so far.
• Pistol movement has been reanimated in order for improved visuals when equipping a pistol in First Person mode.
• Many new item icons fixed or added.
• Plus countless other bug fixes and improvements throughout Stars End.

[b]Bases[/b]

[b]AI[/b]

• Stationary Peacekeeper Walker AI type added.
• Fixed an error with Patrolling Troopers forced into crouch mode.
• Improved footstep sound playback in Peacekeeper Walkers: adjusted volume and falloff, now there's an AudioSource located at both feet to have better sound playback.

--

Thanks to the community who have been providing lots of good information to track down and solve many of the major bugs and issues in Stars End! We are making good progress but there still are a few major issues to solve before we can look at adding more continent, (New Vehicles, Quests & AI Types). 

Another major focus moving forward will be improved visuals. We plan to solve a few of these issues in a short time, such as improved oceans, higher density/performance in ground details like grass, and improved textures and lighting across the board. Some of you have requested a new Hyper-speed visuals for Space Vehicles and that's also something we would like to look at as soon as we can!

Stay safe out there, folks!

notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/fb9bfaa83d4902776242893285dda50ccc784369.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/e75a06e6ce7dc2b4b11c3b68e5a37e92fd00cc34.png[/img][/url]

[h1][i][b]Greetings Outlanders,

Stars End has been updated and the servers are back online! This update has required a database wipe. Patch notes below:[/b][/i][/h1]

[b]Edit: v0.534 is now deployed with several fixes.[/b]

-Major issue resolved with falling through terrain
-Errors resolved in Global Storage
-Mining Grazer working again on BP rocks
-Fixed dialog on Radar Quest End npc
-20 more slots added to Inventory, as it was filling fast.
-Iron Resource now obtainable from an Iron Deposit at Clayton Mine (and will also be added to other mines around the system as we create them.)


[u][b]Changelog - v0.533[/b][/u]

• Base placement network error resolved.
• Players now calculate their own universe positions earlier in load cycles.
• Added code to stop player art showing while in a loading screen, they will now show up to other players when they are fully loaded.
• Players can no longer drop items when inside vehicle or ferry.
• Item weight issues sorted.
• A lot of old item code removed.
• Ferry leaving Delta Outpost now arrives after ordering from Vendor.
• Fixed an error in reloading player owned vehicles after a server reboot.
• Fixed an issue with foliage renderer not spawning the last model in a list.
• Fixed hitboxes on GravCells for Janson Orbital Quest - much easier to control.
• Post-processing fixed in the intro.
• Clamping added to camera rotation inside ground vehicle, ferry and train.
• Third person camera enabled while sleeping.
• Fixed a bug where, after trying to wake up while still sleeping, the camera would not correctly go back to the previous mode.
• Player prevented from interacting with nearby objects while sleeping.
• Improvements to NPC's skin material.
• Beds updated across the system with various fixes (there are probably a few we haven't yet fixed!)
• Players can no longer run with stamina below 10.
• Stamina at zero will slow player movement.
• You now lose slightly more stamina while jogging (was previously almost zero).

[b]Encumbered[/b]
• Encumbered added - you will no longer automatically drop items and can pick up anything, however it will slow your speed all the way until you can no longer move.
• Players no longer gain health or stamina while encumbered.
• Players get hungry, thirsty and tired twice as fast while encumbered.
• Now encumbered is implemented, MakeshiftBackpack now requires a separately made BackpackShell and takes a bit longer to craft.

[b]AI[/b]
• Peacekeeper AI mode added where certain AI will only attack if provoked.
• Changed the way AI spawns, to avoid double AI respawning.
• Some changes to network positioning on AI.
• AI will no longer drop two loot containers when dead.
• Cleaned up AI code.
• Peacekeeper [i]Mechanical Walkers[/i] added to Redberry, Clayton and Delta Outpost
• AI Troopers now spawn in Beta Prairie environment.
• AI troopers added to Mercantile Tower.
• AI Scout ships are re-enabled at Kallus Station and all Orbital Stations

[i]We have also added new AI Wildlife types, spawning on planets as follows:[/i]

• Beta Prairie: ForestCub, Sandsnake & ForestRoach
• Tigon: Trawler
• Janson: IceMites, JansonBears & JansonCubs

[b]Booster Drives[/b]
• Vehicles bought in a store or found in the environment no longer spawn with a Booster Drive and until you buy/craft one you will be mostly bound to the planet you are on.
• BoosterDrive is now craftable and its price has been raised to 60,000. You will need to mine asteroids to create a booster drive.
• Mission Vehicles remain the same and spawn with a Booster Drive where required.

[b]Items[/b]
• Scrap cloth can now be used to stop bleeding.
• PlantFiber is now edible.
• Hide item added : A crafting resource found on dead animals which can be used in a variety of crafting recipes.
• MakeshiftBow now requires Hide, WoodSticks & ScrapCloth.
• Wood Arrow requires WoodStick, Flint & ScrapCloth.
• Sleeping bag requires ScrapCloth & Hide.
• Carpets now require Hide.
• Bread requires Dough.
• Sugar and Salt added for various recipes.
• Campfire now requires WoodLog, Rock and ScrapCloth.
• RawBugMeat item renamed to RawMeat and updated in various recipe's.
• CamoGreenBoonie item now wearable.
• Hat and Backpack vendors added to the Exchange.
• Clothing vendor at Exchange now has many more options.
• Mining changes: rocks on a planet will give you Rock + Flint, Asteroids give Rock + Iron. Iron is now much rarer and pricier.

notes.title: Major Update this week
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/494e1d09cd50149fa46e5ba588fce3130ab2eb32.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/33bb21ef3d276719b23fa7fd39c1b313e63f62d8.png[/img][/url]

Hey Everyone,

It`s been quite here lately as we`ve been working on a major update over the past several weeks. Finally we are nearing completion and expect the update to go live later this week. Changes are massive, too many to preview really, but lets just say that this will be a massive step forward. Some of the major features include:

-Completing the solar system, with 5 planets, 4 moons, 1 gas giant, 3 major space station hubs, full ferry network between all planets, stations and moons, final positions for planets
-New planet designs, vegetation and more
-Populating space with asteroids, massive asteroid belts
-Completely rework of the GUI
-Foundation of a massive crafting system with 314 items and receipts (not everything will be operational yet)

This update also takes care of a lot of other work under the hood that will allow us to introduce more creatures, items, crafting receipts and 100s of randomized space station in the follow up update later in March.

[b]Part 1 of the update it out![/b]
Hey guys - so the update is live, but there are some minor problems here and there, and we are still need to enable Asteroids, new Crafting system and new planet environments. We are looking to have the second part of this update - towards Friday morning.

notes.title: Update v0.2.5 - Beta Prairie 2.0
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/916afbb9d714b94d37637a9e101ec8a9cb8d9550.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/211012ab70d6638ac55fbce2ae00c7d9181ed89a.png[/img][/url]

Attention Colonists, a large new update has landed for Stars End. We have reworked several major elements and while there are hundreds of fixes, only major changes are listed below. And of-course, it`s our pleasure to present you with Beta Prarie 2.0 - a good look at what final planets will look like. New Beta Prairie planet is huge - roughly 10x the size of the old planet. It features over 25km of new highways, redesigned towns and dozens of new POIs. 

Next up - we are working on several very big and exciting features. First of all - full localization will be added within a week or so, including Korean, Chinese, Russian, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish. Up next is the big space station update, populating the universe with 100s of space stations for players to explore or claim. At the same time we hope to add huge asteroid belts. And lets not forget the NOVa - the near orbit vehicle that will enable going into space even in very early game. 

Same time we are working on finally getting the finalized gathering and crafting into the game, but this is a huge project that will take us towards the end of February.

And so.... presenting [b]update 0.2.5[/b]:


[b]Steam and Accounts[/b]
• The database has been wiped
• Steam ID Changed - the game no longer uses your steam name as your ID but a backend steam ID.
• Security enabled so the game can no longer be loaded outside of steam.
• First and Last Name added to creation screen

[b]Beta Prairie 2.0[/b]
• A new version of Beta Prairie has been added, which is roughly 10x the size of the old planet. New highways, towns and POIs have been enabled around the planet.
• The major POIs of Clayton Shire are Redberry, Clayton and Area 22.
• 30 minor POIs have been created which spawn procedurally around the planet
• About 25km of new road has been layed across the shire (and so much more coming soon!)

[b]Territory Capture[/b]
• Territory capture has been re-coded from the ground up. In order to support a large amount of territories to control, some big changes had to be made.
• Capture territory by joining a faction - owning a territory allows you to spawn directly in town.
• The respawn screen has been revised to reflect point capture changes
• Players now only have to stand near a point to begin capturing.
• Further UI enhances have been added, such as the territory tab in Inventory, and Flashing ABC icons if the point is being captured
• Join a faction quest enabled if you either finish or skip tutorial

[b]Misc[/b]
• Reworked the way items and backpacks are retrieved at startup, potentially fixing the inventory issues (requires testing).
• Procedural substance textures removed, potentially fixing a crash when joining a server (requires testing).
• Ground vehicles now spawn in environment - find them around clayton shire there are only a certain number of vehicles allowed to spawn at any one time. Make sure you take care of your vehicle or another player might get hold of it! (space fighter spawns coming next patch)
• A bug at loading screen is resolved which was causing players to get stuck on retrieving position if character creation was not completed previously
• Procedural building stairs and ramps should no longer cause a shake if going up them
• Procedural buildings door issue is resolved
• Makeshift backpack recipe added as a temporary measure for increasing weight
• Improved error console reporting created for server

notes.title: Developers Blog # 1
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/b17bba3d3dac6933ffc60e9ec94fed7af956c3e4.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/c228987fb1942a241bbad0421a29d5e907a94fc1.png[/img][/url]

Howdy Colonists and Welcome to Stars End - Dev Blog 1!

This is our bi-weekly Dev Blog going over recent features and changes in the game.  We can't wait to let our dedicated players into the game, but for now this is how we plan to engage our community.

We are very interested in your feedback! Hard-core survival is a difficult thing to balance and get right - Is it too easy? Too hard? How long does it take a player to get a weapon and a full clip of bullets for example? How long is too long to build a base? These are all questions we hope to resolve alongside you, the community! (And well.. if we can get it right the first time we can all go home i s'pose!)

Before we get started on our latest features I'd like to point out that we have Discord and Reddit channels available at the link below. We love hearing from you so this is a direct line for you to speak to us! Get your feature suggestions in quick, if it seems like it would fit in the Stars End survival sandbox we will certainly evaluate your suggestion!

Discord Server: https://discord.gg/NZ3yM2E

Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/PlayStarsEnd/

The game has come a very long way since the Announcement Trailer was filmed so let's find out some of the latest features in Stars End!
 
[u][b]Introduction Mission[/b][/u]
[i][b]James Booth[/b][/i]

I've been busy working on the Introduction Mission for Stars End. It works as a tutorial for the most part but includes voice acted NPC's and our new Mission Vehicles, which are disposable vehicles that are spawned and expire for a player during a mission, making missions not dependable on vehicle ownership.

Outside of the intro I'm working on some major server optimizations and also getting ready to move back to survival game play. We have a whole set of base building components ready to drop in - the wood tier, and also weight/muscle will finally be factoring into the body sim.

Various other items have come into play recently including the Compass, Basic Region Maps and the ability to pick up placed sleeping bags other players have left behind. In time all items in a makeshift camp will be able to be picked and relocated to a new position.

Check out the footage below for some recent additions to Stars End!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uNMbjPCDc3g
 

[u][b]Procedural Space Stations (WIP)[/b][/u]
[i][b]Daniel Kole[/b][/i]

I am currently continuing work on the Space Stations 3D Models and generation systems. There are many components that fit together to allow us to create any number of Space Station layouts and designs. From long corridors to wide open Docking Bays and Command Decks, all fit together seamlessly.

This week I’m adding a new room type to my already completed pieces along with other small 3D models and coding it all to fit together to create Space Stations that players will visit across the system.


http://starsend.reverieworld.com/wp-content/uploads/photo-gallery/daniel4.jpg

http://starsend.reverieworld.com/wp-content/uploads/photo-gallery/daniel2.jpg



[u][b]Space Effects and Nebulas[/b][/u]
[i][b]John Siffrin[/b][/i]


Hello everyone! I have currently been working on making the universe and space, look good. The first thing I did was remove the old skybox to replace it with a 3D system. I then had to set up a star system. I used four different types of stars that pulsate and can be flown past. Now when you initiate the booster drive, you really will know!

The second part of the skybox I worked on was a cloud system. For this, I used three different types of clouds, four colors, that all dynamically move. The hardest part of this is getting the cloud patterns to look good, and have a great color. This is something I will continue to work on in the future.

The last thing I did was some Post FX adjustments, to get the sun, planets, and stars to really pop out at you. For this upcoming week, I will continue tweaking the 3D star box system, and start adding new content to explore and see in space.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcefrl5HlfQ
 
[b][u]Update Notes (0.2.2.2 - 0.2.2.4)[/b][/u]
• Ferry Network Fixes.
• Tigon Hangar Changes.
• Screen Resolution and Overall Graphics Settings added to the Main Menu.
• Revised Tutorial Prompt, plus added much earlier in the loading. Players no longer need to die and respawn to bypass.
• AI voices added throughout the tutorial.
• Tooltips added throughout the tutorial.
• Network/Server optimizations.
• Vehicle bug fixes.
• Kallus Station Ferry will now appear in the correct position.
• Mission Rover position fixes
• Mission Rover Fuel increased by 10%.
• AI Enemy audio fixes (Requires testing! Let us know!)
• New item! Clayton Shire Map
• Loot containers added to an area of Titan Ship and Tigon Hangar

notes.title: Developers Blog # 1
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/b17bba3d3dac6933ffc60e9ec94fed7af956c3e4.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31259450/c228987fb1942a241bbad0421a29d5e907a94fc1.png[/img][/url]

Howdy Colonists and Welcome to Stars End - Dev Blog 1!

This is our bi-weekly Dev Blog going over recent features and changes in the game.  We can't wait to let our dedicated players into the game, but for now this is how we plan to engage our community.

We are very interested in your feedback! Hard-core survival is a difficult thing to balance and get right - Is it too easy? Too hard? How long does it take a player to get a weapon and a full clip of bullets for example? How long is too long to build a base? These are all questions we hope to resolve alongside you, the community! (And well.. if we can get it right the first time we can all go home i s'pose!)

Before we get started on our latest features I'd like to point out that we have Discord and Reddit channels available at the link below. We love hearing from you so this is a direct line for you to speak to us! Get your feature suggestions in quick, if it seems like it would fit in the Stars End survival sandbox we will certainly evaluate your suggestion!

Discord Server: https://discord.gg/NZ3yM2E

Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/PlayStarsEnd/

The game has come a very long way since the Announcement Trailer was filmed so let's find out some of the latest features in Stars End!
 
[u][b]Introduction Mission[/b][/u]
[i][b]James Booth[/b][/i]

I've been busy working on the Introduction Mission for Stars End. It works as a tutorial for the most part but includes voice acted NPC's and our new Mission Vehicles, which are disposable vehicles that are spawned and expire for a player during a mission, making missions not dependable on vehicle ownership.

Outside of the intro I'm working on some major server optimizations and also getting ready to move back to survival game play. We have a whole set of base building components ready to drop in - the wood tier, and also weight/muscle will finally be factoring into the body sim.

Various other items have come into play recently including the Compass, Basic Region Maps and the ability to pick up placed sleeping bags other players have left behind. In time all items in a makeshift camp will be able to be picked and relocated to a new position.

Check out the footage below for some recent additions to Stars End!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uNMbjPCDc3g
 

[u][b]Procedural Space Stations (WIP)[/b][/u]
[i][b]Daniel Kole[/b][/i]

I am currently continuing work on the Space Stations 3D Models and generation systems. There are many components that fit together to allow us to create any number of Space Station layouts and designs. From long corridors to wide open Docking Bays and Command Decks, all fit together seamlessly.

This week I’m adding a new room type to my already completed pieces along with other small 3D models and coding it all to fit together to create Space Stations that players will visit across the system.


http://starsend.reverieworld.com/wp-content/uploads/photo-gallery/daniel4.jpg

http://starsend.reverieworld.com/wp-content/uploads/photo-gallery/daniel2.jpg



[u][b]Space Effects and Nebulas[/b][/u]
[i][b]John Siffrin[/b][/i]


Hello everyone! I have currently been working on making the universe and space, look good. The first thing I did was remove the old skybox to replace it with a 3D system. I then had to set up a star system. I used four different types of stars that pulsate and can be flown past. Now when you initiate the booster drive, you really will know!

The second part of the skybox I worked on was a cloud system. For this, I used three different types of clouds, four colors, that all dynamically move. The hardest part of this is getting the cloud patterns to look good, and have a great color. This is something I will continue to work on in the future.

The last thing I did was some Post FX adjustments, to get the sun, planets, and stars to really pop out at you. For this upcoming week, I will continue tweaking the 3D star box system, and start adding new content to explore and see in space.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lcefrl5HlfQ
